theory Batch_Check_603a16cd590afafe
  imports
    "CRefine_Semantic_Base.Semantic_Root"
begin

unbundle l4v_word_context

ML \<open>writeln "REGEN_NODE goal:b6b0c86e4105cb63c3fa"\<close>
ML \<open>writeln ("REGEN_TIMING_START goal:b6b0c86e4105cb63c3fa " ^ Time.toString (Time.now ()))\<close>
context kernel
begin
lemma get_tsType_ccorres[corres]:
  "ccorres (\<lambda>r r'. r' = thread_state_to_tsType r) ret__unsigned_' (tcb_at' thread)
           ({s. f s = tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr thread} \<inter>
            {s. cslift s (Ptr &(f s\<rightarrow>[''tcbState_C''])) = Some (thread_state_' s)}) []
  (getThreadState thread) (Call thread_state_get_tsType_'proc)"
apply (rule ccorres_from_vcg)
apply (intro allI)
apply (rule hoare_complete)
apply (rule HoarePartialDef.validI)
apply clarsimp
subgoal premises prems for abstract_state c_state outcome
proof -
  note functional = structures_proofs.kernel_all_substitute.thread_state_get_tsType_spec[rule_format, where symbol_table=symbol_table and domain=domain and s=c_state]
  have functional_post:
    "outcome \<in> Normal ` {s. ret__unsigned_' s = tsType_CL (thread_state_lift (thread_state_' c_state))}"
    using hoare_sound[OF functional] prems(1)
    by (auto simp: HoarePartialDef.cvalid_def HoarePartialDef.valid_def)
  have frame:
    "kernel_all_substitute.\<Gamma> symbol_table domain
       \<turnstile> {c_state} Call thread_state_get_tsType_'proc
              {s. globals s = globals c_state}"
    apply (rule HoarePartial.ProcBody[where P'="{c_state}" and body="kernel_all_substitute.thread_state_get_tsType_body"])
      apply simp
     unfolding Substitute.kernel_all_substitute.thread_state_get_tsType_body_def
     apply vcg
     apply simp
    apply (simp add: Substitute.kernel_all_substitute.thread_state_get_tsType_impl
                     Substitute.kernel_all_substitute.thread_state_get_tsType_body_def)
    done
  have frame_post:
    "outcome \<in> Normal ` {s. globals s = globals c_state}"
    using hoare_sound[OF frame] prems(1) functional_post
    by (auto simp: HoarePartialDef.cvalid_def HoarePartialDef.valid_def)
  obtain final_state where out: "outcome = Normal final_state"
    and ret: "ret__unsigned_' final_state = tsType_CL (thread_state_lift (thread_state_' c_state))"
    using functional_post by auto
  have globals_eq: "globals final_state = globals c_state"
    using frame_post out by auto
  have rf_final: "(abstract_state, final_state) \<in> rf_sr"
    using prems(5) globals_eq
    by (simp add: rf_sr_def)
  have nonempty: "fst (getThreadState thread abstract_state) \<noteq> {}"
    using EmptyFail.empty_fail_getThreadState
          KHeap_R.no_fail_getThreadState prems(2)
    by (auto simp: Nondet_Empty_Fail.empty_fail_def
                   Nondet_No_Fail.no_fail_def)
  obtain result_pair where result_pair:
    "result_pair \<in> fst (getThreadState thread abstract_state)"
    using nonempty by blast
  obtain rv abstract_state' where pair:
    "result_pair = (rv, abstract_state')"
    by (cases result_pair; simp)
  have result:
    "(rv, abstract_state') \<in> fst (getThreadState thread abstract_state)"
    using result_pair pair by simp
  have rf_result: "(abstract_state', final_state) \<in> rf_sr"
    using TcbAcc_R.threadGet_inv[where P="\<lambda>s. (s, final_state) \<in> rf_sr"
          and f=tcbState and t=thread] result rf_final
    unfolding Thread_H.getThreadState_def Nondet_VCG.valid_def
    by blast
  obtain tcb where ko: "ko_at' tcb thread abstract_state'"
    and rv_eq: "tcbState tcb = rv"
    using TcbAcc_R.threadGet_sp[where P="\<lambda>_. True"
          and f=tcbState and ptr=thread] result
    unfolding Thread_H.getThreadState_def Nondet_VCG.valid_def
    by blast
  have amap:
    "map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state') thread = Some tcb"
    using ko
    unfolding Invariants_H.obj_at'_real_def Invariants_H.ko_wp_at'_def
    by clarsimp
  have cpspace:
    "cpspace_relation (ksPSpace abstract_state')
       (underlying_memory (ksMachineState abstract_state'))
       (t_hrs_' (globals final_state))"
    using rf_result
    unfolding rf_sr_def state_rel.cstate_relation_def
    by (simp only: Let_def; blast)
  have tcb_space:
    "cpspace_tcb_relation (ksPSpace abstract_state')
       (t_hrs_' (globals final_state))"
    using cpspace
    unfolding cpspace_relation_def
    by blast
  have tcb_map_rel:
    "cmap_relation (map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state'))
       (cslift final_state) tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr ctcb_relation"
    using tcb_space by assumption
  have adom:
    "thread \<in> dom (map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state'))"
    apply (rule domI)
    apply (rule amap)
    done
  have dom_eq:
    "tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr ` dom (map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state')) =
     dom (cslift final_state)"
    using tcb_map_rel
    unfolding cmap_relation_def
    by blast
  have cdom:
    "tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr thread \<in> dom (cslift final_state)"
    using adom dom_eq by blast
  obtain ctcb where cobj:
    "cslift final_state (tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr thread) = Some ctcb"
    using cdom by auto
  have pointwise:
    "\<forall>x\<in>dom (map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state')).
       ctcb_relation (the (map_to_tcbs (ksPSpace abstract_state') x))
         (the (cslift final_state (tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr x)))"
    using tcb_map_rel
    unfolding cmap_relation_def
    by blast
  have ctcb_rel: "ctcb_relation tcb ctcb"
    using pointwise[rule_format, OF adom] amap cobj
    by simp
  have field_final:
    "cslift final_state
       (PTR(thread_state_C) &(tcb_ptr_to_ctcb_ptr thread\<rightarrow>[''tcbState_C''])) =
     Some (tcbState_C ctcb)"
    using TypHeapLib.clift_field[where 'b=thread_state_C,
          OF cobj Kernel_C.tcb_C_tcbState_C_fl_ti]
    by simp
  have state_eq: "tcbState_C ctcb = thread_state_' c_state"
    using field_final prems(3) prems(4) globals_eq
    by simp
  have value_eq:
    "thread_state_to_tsType rv =
     tsType_CL (thread_state_lift (thread_state_' c_state))"
    using ctcb_rel rv_eq state_eq
    unfolding ctcb_relation_def cthread_state_relation_def
    by (cases rv; simp_all)
  show ?thesis
    apply (simp only: out image_iff)
    apply (rule bexI[where x=final_state])
     apply simp
    apply (simp only: mem_Collect_eq)
    apply (rule bexI[where x="(rv, abstract_state')"])
     apply (simp add: rf_result ret value_eq)
    apply (rule result)
    done
qed
done
end
ML \<open>writeln ("REGEN_TIMING_END goal:b6b0c86e4105cb63c3fa " ^ Time.toString (Time.now ()))\<close>
